_comment: TEMPLATE. Copy to app-config.json and fill in real values. app-config.json is gitignored because env_variables carries secrets (the token signing key) and this repository is public. Values set in the Catalyst console override these after deploy.

env_variables._comment_db: SQLite on /tmp is the AppSail path: the app directory is read-only and /tmp is writable. /tmp is also wiped on restart, so KSP_STRATUS_BUCKET below is what makes writes durable. A PostgreSQL connection string also works and is the production scale-out route.
env_variables._comment_stratus: Catalyst Stratus bucket. The whole SQLite file is snapshotted here after each write and restored on the first request after a restart. Without this, ephemeral SQLite silently loses every write and deploy.ps1 refuses to deploy. The bucket must already exist in your Catalyst project (Stratus > Create Bucket, Authenticated access). The name becomes a DNS host, so use lowercase and hyphens only.
env_variables._comment_optional: Optional Catalyst services. Each degrades to a documented fallback when unset, and GET /api/system/services reports the real status.
